conclusion: Real PII module catches 10/15 PII types via regex (IDs, phones, bank cards, emails). The 5 Chinese person names (张伟/李娜/王芳/赵磊/孙琪) are missed because the NER ONNX model is missing (sanitize_ready=false). The other 4 PII tokens (2 addresses, 1 password, 1 API key) are missed because the regex patterns for those Chinese-localized forms are not in the deployed module. user 's original feedback is partially validated: the 'Chinese PII leak' is concentrated in CN_PERSON. Other Chinese PII types ARE caught by regex (CN_SSN / CN_PHONE / CN_BANKCARD / CN_EMAIL).
